items.name: Sommerglück Wassermelone
items.description: A whole round green watermelon with soft dark stripes and a red half-moon slice with seeds in front, natural proportions. Invented German brand Sommerglück.

items.name: Hainfee Süßkirschen
items.description: Fat glass jar of sweet cherries in dark purple syrup with a sun-yellow screw lid and a cream label showing two red cherries. Invented German brand Hainfee.

items.name: Sonni Pfirsichhälften
items.description: Fat candy-pink can of peach halves with metal rims, a silver pull-tab lid and a cream label showing one big orange peach with a green leaf. Invented German brand Sonni.

items.name: Südlust Trockenmango
items.description: Fat standing pouch of dried mango in sun yellow with an orange crimped seal and a cream label panel showing one orange mango. Invented German brand Südlust.
